items.name: Explicit SI dynamics boundary
acceptance: Convert length, velocity, acceleration, volume, density, inertia, force and torque consistently at one documented SI boundary.
Millimeter-to-meter scale is 1e-3; kg*mm^2 to kg*m^2 is 1e-6 and N*mm to N*m is 1e-3; retain explicit mass/time units.

items.name: Gravity configuration
acceptance: Use local constant lunar gravity for the small demo and keep its frame and source visible.

items.name: Mass center and inertia
acceptance: Require finite positive mass and a finite symmetric inertia tensor in a declared center-of-mass frame with explicit units.
Principal inertia moments must be positive and satisfy physical triangle inequalities within a documented tolerance; positive definiteness alone is insufficient.
Mass distribution, density assumptions, source geometry and any approximation carry provenance.

items.name: Appearance-independent physical properties
acceptance: Never infer friction, elasticity or density from visual roughness or color.

items.name: Fixed simulation step
acceptance: Separate simulation integration, viewport refresh and output frame rate.

items.name: Deterministic replay manifest
acceptance: Record seed, solver version, step policy and initial state; define cross-platform tolerances.

items.name: Error-controlled substeps
acceptance: Refine fast or stiff events within a bounded compute budget.

items.name: Broad and narrow collision phases
acceptance: Use bounded collision representations with documented shape correspondence.

items.name: Continuous collision detection
acceptance: Prevent a fast vial or gripper from tunneling through another shape.

items.name: Contact friction and restitution
acceptance: Use calibrated or explicitly illustrative contact pairs and solve energy-consistent impulses.

items.name: Contact compliance and damping
acceptance: Bound penetration and avoid unstable perfectly rigid capture constraints.

items.name: Resting contact stabilization
acceptance: Prevent stored vials and grounded wheels from drifting or gaining energy.

items.name: Revolute and prismatic joint limits
acceptance: Read verified joint frames and limits; reject impossible assembly motions.

items.name: Motor effort and speed limits
acceptance: Bound actuator torque, force, velocity and acceleration.

items.name: Inverse kinematics with reachability
acceptance: Plan arm targets within joint and collision constraints.

items.name: Closed-loop mechanism support
acceptance: Handle linkage constraints without silently breaking loops.

items.name: Hoses cables and clearances
acceptance: Use a declared collision or visual approximation for flexible service lines.

items.name: Kinematic-to-dynamic release
acceptance: Transfer center-of-mass linear and angular velocity once at the release event, including v_COM = v_grip + omega_grip cross r.
Removing the grasp constraint introduces no unexplained position, orientation, linear-momentum or angular-momentum discontinuity.

items.name: Free-flight propagation
acceptance: Use gravity and declared forces; remove grip constraints during flight.

items.name: Intercept planning
acceptance: Choose a reachable catch pose and time based on relative motion.

items.name: Contact-mediated capture
acceptance: Require real contact and bounded impulse before establishing the grip.

items.name: Storage and latch state
acceptance: Confirm cassette contact and retention before releasing the gripper.

items.name: Container open and sealed states
acceptance: Track lid closure and reject sealed-sample claims when the geometry is open.

items.name: Sample mass bookkeeping
acceptance: Conserve collected, spilled and stored sample mass across state changes.

items.name: Granular fill approximation levels
acceptance: Distinguish aggregate mass, explicit particles and calibrated granular mechanics.

items.name: Particle contact and cohesion
acceptance: Keep particle size, shape, packing and cohesive assumptions explicit.

items.name: Ballistic lunar dust
acceptance: Use vacuum trajectories; additional electrostatic or plume forces require their own model.

items.name: Scoop and terrain interaction
acceptance: Define excavation, displacement and reaction forces instead of visual-only contact.

items.name: Analytic ballistic references
acceptance: Check apex, time of flight and landing location against closed-form cases.

items.name: Energy and momentum diagnostics
acceptance: Track integration drift and account for actuator work and collision losses.

items.name: Time-step convergence
acceptance: Repeat representative release and catch events at smaller steps.

items.name: Scale and unit invariance
acceptance: Compare equivalent millimeter and meter input fixtures after conversion.

items.name: Physics bake and cache
acceptance: Store an immutable approved trajectory with source and parameter hashes.

items.name: Shutter-time interpolation
acceptance: Provide physically coherent transforms at every requested exposure time.

items.name: Failure recovery
acceptance: Report missed catch, collision or solver failure without teleporting to a success pose.

items.name: Non-destructive design integration
acceptance: Keep simulation state and collision proxies separate from CAD design geometry.
